global.description: Global values that apply to all charts See more info about global values [here](/truecharts-common/global)

namespace.description: Namespace to apply to all objects, unless overridden at the object level Does not apply to chart deps, use global.namespace for that

chartContext.description: Details about the release that common works out on every render.

common.description: Values to merge into the common chart defaults before chart-specific overrides.

securityContext.description: Define security context for all containers and pods, unless overridden at the container/pod level See more info about securityContext [here](/truecharts-common/securitycontext)

resources.description: Define resources for all containers, unless overridden at the container level Resources apply to **EACH** container, not to the pod as a whole.

containerOptions.description: Options that apply to all containers, unless overridden at the container level See more info about containerOptions [here](/truecharts-common/containeroptions)

podOptions.description: Options that apply to all pods, unless overridden at the pod level See more info about podOptions [here](/truecharts-common/podoptions)

TZ.description: Timezone that is used everywhere applicable, unless overridden at the container level

diagnosticMode.description: Run the containers with a sleep command instead of the app, to debug them.

configMapsFromFolder.description: Generate ConfigMaps from a folder structure in the Helm chart's filesystem

secret.description: Define the secret If this is set, the `users` key must not be set.

externalSecret.description: ExternalSecrets that load secrets from an external store, keyed by name.

gluetunImage.description: Image `gluetunImage`, selected by containers with `imageSelector: gluetunImage`.

netshootImage.description: Image `netshootImage`, selected by containers with `imageSelector: netshootImage`.

tailscaleImage.description: Image `tailscaleImage`, selected by containers with `imageSelector: tailscaleImage`.

codeserverImage.description: Image `codeserverImage`, selected by containers with `imageSelector: codeserverImage`.

postgresql18Image.description: Image `postgresql18Image`, selected by containers with `imageSelector: postgresql18Image`.

mariadbImage.description: Image of the mariadb dependency, selected by its container.

memcachedImage.description: Image of the memcached dependency, selected by its container.

mongodbImage.description: Image of the mongodb dependency, selected by its container.

valkeyImage.description: Image of the valkey dependency, selected by its container in `standalone` mode and by `dependencies.valkey.operator.imageSelector` in `operator` mode.

valkeyExporterImage.description: Image of the metrics exporter of the valkey dependency in `operator` mode, selected by `dependencies.valkey.operator.exporter.imageSelector`.
